chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah and others, that he wrote to him asking him about the Kurds, so he wrote back to him:
Do not awaken them except by the edge of the sword.

key_terms.الْأَكْرَادِ: The Kurds, a specific ethnic group mentioned in the text
key_terms.بِحَدِّ السَّيْفِ: By the edge of the sword, implying military action or waking them through combat

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling regarding the Kurds in Shia jurisprudence according to Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This correspondence from Al-Kafi highlights the practical application of authority by the Imams regarding specific tribal groups, where 'Al-Akrad' (Kurds) were instructed to be provoked only by the sword, implying a state of readiness for conflict or a distinct legal status. This ruling reflects the geopolitical realities of the early Islamic period, where tribal autonomy and occasional raids necessitated clear directives on when to initiate military engagement versus maintaining peace.
